description: Record of the v0.5 hash fix (ITL-898). v0.4.0 lost information for some types (byte-layout spec Section 10); v0.5 fixes the layout, so hashes of affected inputs move. reference_vectors: every option-free vector of the v0.5 golden fixture, with its v0.4.0 hash (computed by the released v0.4.0 crate) and its v0.5 hash. A vector whose type is unaffected must keep its digest (the 32 bytes after the 3-byte version prefix). existing_tests: every pre-existing test value that changed.
affected_rule: A record batch / stream / hash_array input is affected iff its type contains a Boolean (also as a dictionary value type), a nullable struct (for hash_array, the array itself counts as nullable iff it has a null), or a list / large list whose element field is nullable and is a list or a struct. hash_schema is never affected. Unaffected inputs hash byte-identically to v0.4.0; affected inputs may move (they do for all but degenerate data, e.g. zero rows, all-null Booleans, or a single true Boolean).

defect_labels.boolean_packing: Boolean values were bit-packed per call with no count: trailing false values were lost (non-nullable) and the hash depended on batch boundaries. Now one byte per valid value.
defect_labels.nullable_struct: A null struct hashed like a struct whose fields are all null, and null struct rows vanished when the fields were non-nullable. Now a nullable struct records its own validity bits.
defect_labels.list_of_nullable_list: A list whose element is a nullable list lost its own per-row lengths (its element entry was replaced). Now the element entry keeps the lengths and records the element validity.
defect_labels.list_of_nullable_struct: In a list of nullable structs a null element hashed like an element with all-null fields. Now the element validity is recorded in the list element entry.

existing_tests.input: record batch with a nullable Boolean column "flags"
record batch col: Boolean nullable [true, null, false, true] (byte-layout test)
record batch col: Boolean non-null [false, true, false] (byte-layout test)
hash_array BooleanArray [true, null, false, true] (spec Example B)
hash_array Struct<a: Int32, b: Boolean> [{1,true},{2,false}] (spec Example L)
hash_array nullable Struct<a, b> with a null row (spec Example M)
